item.title: AWS: Service is operating normally: [RESOLVED] Elevated packet loss (eu-south-2)
item.description: Between 8:48 AM and 11:28 AM PDT, we experienced elevated packet loss within a single Availability Zone (eus2-az1) in the EU-SOUTH-2 Region. This issue resulted in elevated API latencies and error rates for multiple workflows and AWS Services.
